name: Base Colour
definition: The colours of the apparel are used directly for the material: the material is needed in the same colours as the garment.
example: Garment in 372, 3909 and 475 → the material is also used in 372, 3909 and 475.

name: Table
definition: The user maps each apparel colour to a material colour. It tells the system "buy the fabric in this colour to achieve the apparel in that colour". The apparel colour master and the fabric (or any raw material) colour master can differ, so this map bridges them.
example: Fabric N-8: apparel colour 372 → fabric colour 372, 3909 → 3909, 475 → 475.

name: None
definition: The material has no colour. It is the same for every apparel colour (for example a polybag).

name: Base Size
definition: The apparel sizes are used directly for the material: the material comes in the same sizes as the garment.

name: Table
definition: The user maps each apparel size to a material size (or leaves it unused), when the material is not sized like the garment.
example: Fabric N-8: 34S → 34S, 38M → 38M, 42L1 → 42L1; the larger sizes are not mapped.

name: None
definition: The material has no size. It is the same for every apparel size.
